[[File:Jungle horror icon.png|left]]
'''Jungle horrors''' are [[monster]]s that live on the island of [[Mos Le'Harmless]] and use [[melee]] attacks. Jungle horrors can be assigned as a [[Slayer]] task by [[Mazchna]] and [[Chaeldar]].

They have relatives inside [[Mos Le'Harmless Caves|the caves]] on the island, called [[cave horror]]s and [[unspeakable horror]]s.

==Strategy==
{{cquote2|The last Jungle horror I killed I found water spells took them down effectively.

Jungle horrors can be found all over Mos Le'Harmless. They are strong and aggressive, but you should be heroic enough to make short work of them.|[[Chaeldar]]}}

Jungle horrors can be [[ranged]] or [[magic|maged]] from the platform on the outskirt of the township, and bringing a long-ranged weapon such as a [[longbow (bow type)|longbow]] or [[two-handed crossbow]] when ranging helps as they can be scattered around. The various jungle plants can be ranged across, and the jungle trees can be used as safe spots as well. Another good safe spot is the [[wheat]] field north-east of Mos Le'Harmless. Standing in the eastern edge of the wheat field is recommended, because they cannot attack past the fence.

Melee can also be effective, particularly with two-handed weapons and area-of-effect abilities. In some areas of the jungle, there are three or four Horrors in the same area, which can be quickly killed right after each other.

Players with high [[Defence]] do not need to pay much attention while fighting Jungle horrors. Since Jungle horrors are highly [[aggressiveness|aggressive]] and have a large hunt radius, those players can simply stand in a spot with many Jungle horrors, with [[Auto Retaliate]] on, and kill them without even doing anything. This is best accomplished with [[Ancient Magicks]] when maging or a [[halberd]] when meleeing. Occasionally, players should check their life points and eat if necessary, which should not happen often as the horrors can easily be killed in two to three hits. Jungle horrors may become [[tolerance|tolerant]] over longer periods of time.

==Trivia==
* They have two different types of attacks: one where the jungle horror attacks with its fists, and one where it kicks you.
* They previously had three forms - large-sized grey, medium dark green, and small light green ones. They also had different coloured eyes: blue, green, pink, red, and yellow.
* Prior to the update on [[12 March]] [[2018]], they had a completely different drop table.
